ONE MODULE, ONE RATIO: the module is the root em, the ratio the sixteenth root of sixteen (1.1892:
   four steps double a size); --eN is the module times ratio^N; every size, space, width, breakpoint and duration below is one of
   them or a whole multiple of one; line heights are the ratio and its square. THE FORM: an inscription; the day's figure, its
   centre empty; what is here, and who is behind it; two doors, one on either side of the figure's axis.
   R the record · M the machine reader · H a standard for human reading · C a constraint · E a choice. */

/* 1 TOKENS. C: the scale. H: two palettes, every text colour at 7:1 or more (WCAG 2.2, 1.4.6); green means a machine wrote it, or
   the day of the CZ count; blue, a reason. C: no typeface is shipped: the reader's serif for people, its monospace for what is exact. */
:root{--e-16:.0625rem;--e-12:.125rem;--e-8:.25rem;--e-4:.5rem;--e-2:.7071rem;--e-1:.8409rem;--e0:1rem;--e1:1.1892rem;--e2:1.4142rem;
--e3:1.6818rem;--e4:2rem;--e5:2.3784rem;--e6:2.8284rem;--e12:8rem;--e14:11.3137rem;--e18:22.6274rem;--e21:38.0546rem;--e22:45.2548rem;
--l1:1.1892;--l2:1.4142;color-scheme:light dark;--bg:#fff;--fg:#111;--mute:#555;--rule:#bbb;--machine:#116329;--why:#0f4c81;
--human:Charter,"Bitstream Charter","Sitka Text",Cambria,serif;--exact:ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono",Consolas,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#101010;--fg:#eee;--mute:#aaa;--rule:#444;--machine:#3fb950;--why:#91c3f6}}

/* 2 BASE. H + M: links underlined, never colour alone (1.4.1); focus always visible (2.4.7); a small link is a target 24 px tall
   (2.5.8). M: exact values in the monospace, one step smaller. */
html{font:100%/var(--l2) var(--human);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg);overflow-wrap:break-word}
.page{max-inline-size:var(--e22);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--e-1)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:var(--e-16);text-underline-offset:.1768em}
:focus-visible{outline:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);outline-offset:var(--e-12)}
time,data,code,pre,.exact{font-family:var(--exact);font-size:.8409em}
p,li{text-wrap:pretty}
.note,.src,.zero,.say,.both,.why,.next,footer{font-size:.8409em;color:var(--mute)}
:is(.note,.src,.date,.who,.both,.key,.next,footer p) a{position:relative}
:is(.note,.src,.date,.who,.both,.key,.next,footer p) a::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:calc(-1*var(--e-8)) 0}

/* 3 HEAD. R: the mark and the name, the way to the page with neither door answered; nothing else. */
.name{margin:0;font-size:var(--e0);line-height:var(--l1)}
.name a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--e-4);min-block-size:var(--e6)}
.name svg{flex:none;inline-size:var(--e4);block-size:var(--e4)}

/* 4 INSCRIPTION. E: the statement leads, the largest words of the page, on the axis; then the day, what is here, who is behind it. */
.axis{text-align:center}
.line{margin:0 0 var(--e-2);font-size:var(--e3);line-height:var(--l1);text-wrap:balance}
.sub{margin:var(--e-2) 0;font-size:var(--e1);text-wrap:balance}
.who{margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
@media(min-width:38.0546rem){
.line{font-size:var(--e5)}
.sub{font-size:var(--e2)}
}

/* 5 FIGURE. R: sixteen rings round an empty centre, each carrying the arc it travelled since the day before, computed from the
   Core's SHA-256 and the day (room/figure.js). M: the markup's attributes are the figure for every browser; where the browser can
   calculate (CSS mod()) it computes the same figure itself from the one number the server wrote, --today, and each ring's three
   constants; --day is registered as a number so that it can move, and a press (a checkbox, no script) moves it by one day. */
.fig-l{display:block;inline-size:var(--e12);margin:0 auto var(--e-4);border-radius:50%}
.fig{display:block;inline-size:100%;block-size:auto;color:var(--machine)}
.trk circle{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:var(--e-16);vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.date,.zero,.say{margin:0}
.date{color:var(--mute)}
.date .d{color:var(--machine);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.axis :is(time,data){font-family:inherit;font-size:1em;white-space:nowrap}
@media(min-width:38.0546rem){
.fig-l{inline-size:var(--e14)}
}
@property --day{syntax:"<number>";inherits:true;initial-value:0}
@property --live{syntax:"<number>";inherits:true;initial-value:1}   /* 1 only where a number can be registered, so that elsewhere nothing half-moves */
@supports (stroke-dashoffset:calc(mod(1,2))){
.fig{--day:var(--today)}
.arc circle{stroke-dashoffset:calc(-1*mod(var(--a) + mod(var(--day) - 1,var(--m))*var(--s),var(--m)))}   /* the inner mod() keeps every product small */
.turn:checked~.fb .fig{--day:calc(var(--today) + 1)}
.turn{display:block;position:absolute;inline-size:var(--e-16);block-size:var(--e-16);margin:0;opacity:0}
.turn:focus-visible~.fb .fig-l{outline:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);outline-offset:var(--e-8)}
.fig-l{cursor:pointer}
.press,.turn:checked~.say .t1{display:inline}
.turn:checked~.say .t0{display:none}
}

/* 6 DOORS. E: the web's question, with both answers open: two doors of one size, one frame cut in two on the figure's axis. M: two
   plain links; the answer is kept in the address (#human, #not-human), so Back undoes it. One registered number, --open, says where the line stands: .5
   with neither answered, 1 for a human, 0 for a reader that is not. Without :has() the two readings follow one another, whole. */
.ask{margin:var(--e0) 0 var(--e-4)}
.ask b{font-size:var(--e1)}
.doors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.door{display:grid;place-items:center;min-block-size:var(--e6);border:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);font-size:var(--e1);font-weight:700;line-height:var(--l1)}
.door.n{border-inline-start:0;font-family:var(--exact);font-size:var(--e0)}
.col:focus{outline:0}   /* a door moves focus into its reading; the reading is not a control */
.col>.in{box-sizing:border-box;padding-block:var(--e-2) var(--e2)}
.in>h2{margin:var(--e0) 0 var(--e-2);font-size:var(--e1);line-height:var(--l1)}
@property --open{syntax:"<number>";inherits:true;initial-value:.5}
@supports selector(:has(a)){
.page{--open:.5;--h:clamp(0,var(--open)*2 - 1,1);--n:clamp(0,1 - var(--open)*2,1)}
.page:has(#human:target){--open:1}
.page:has(#not-human:target){--open:0}
.col{scroll-margin-block-start:calc(var(--e6) + var(--e-4))}   /* an answered door stands at the top of the window, its reading under it */
.in>h2{position:absolute;inline-size:var(--e-16);block-size:var(--e-16);margin:0;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
/* the answered door carries a heavier underline, as the site marks the page one is on. "I am not human": the name is set as data,
   what follows the doors for a human is closed, one plain way back remains */
.page:has(#human:target) .door.h,.page:has(#not-human:target) .door.n{text-decoration-thickness:var(--e-8)}
.page:has(#not-human:target) .door.n{color:var(--machine)}
.page:has(#not-human:target) .name{font-family:var(--exact);font-size:var(--e-1)}
.page:has(#not-human:target) :is(.decl,.next,footer){display:none}
/* from e16 two columns: the human's takes --open of the width, the machine's the rest; what does not fit is covered, not squeezed;
   a closed reading is out of the keyboard's reach */
@media(min-width:16rem){
.stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:calc(var(--open)*100%) minmax(0,1fr);container-type:inline-size;overflow:hidden;overflow:clip}
.col{position:relative;min-inline-size:0;overflow:hidden;overflow:clip}
.col :focus-visible{outline-offset:calc(-1*var(--e-12))}
.col.h>.in{min-inline-size:50cqi;padding-inline-end:calc(var(--e-2)*(1 - var(--h)))}
.col.n>.in{padding-inline-start:calc(var(--e-2)*(1 - var(--n)))}
.col.n{contain:size;margin-inline-start:calc(-1*var(--e-12));border-inline-start:var(--e-12) solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--fg) calc((1 - var(--h) - var(--n))*100%),transparent)}
.raw,.back{display:none}
.page:has(#human:target) .col.n,.page:has(#not-human:target) .col.h{visibility:hidden}
.page:has(#not-human:target) .col.n{contain:none}
.page:has(#not-human:target) .col.h{contain:size}
.page:has(#not-human:target) :is(.raw,.back){display:block}
/* with neither answered each window is a glimpse fading at its lower edge: the human's three titles; the machine's, under its
   label, one header to a line, ending in an ellipsis where it does not fit. Nothing in a glimpse is a control: each door reaches
   down over its window, so a press anywhere in a window answers that door */
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .stage{min-block-size:var(--e14);pointer-events:none}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .col{mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 calc(100% - var(--e4)),transparent)}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) :is(.more,.req,.bd,.sum){display:none}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .steps{flex-direction:column;row-gap:var(--e-2)}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .steps>li{flex:none}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .x{overflow:hidden}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .hd>span{padding:0;overflow:hidden;text-indent:0;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:pre}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .door{position:relative}
.page:not(:has(.col:target)) .door::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:100% 0 auto;block-size:var(--e14)}
}
/* narrower than e16: an answered door closes the other reading */
@media not all and (min-width:16rem){
.page:has(#human:target) .col.n,.page:has(#not-human:target) .col.h{display:none}
}
}

/* 7 REGISTERS. E: the human's reading is three numbered steps: read, say, ask your AI. One grammar: a number and a title, then one
   control, at least e6 tall (2.5.8); the step to take now is filled, the page's one filled control. */
.steps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--e1) var(--e3);margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:step;font-size:calc(var(--e0) + (var(--e1) - var(--e0))*var(--h,1))}
.steps>li{flex:1 1 var(--e18);min-inline-size:0;counter-increment:step}
.t{display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--e-2) minmax(0,1fr);gap:var(--e-2);align-items:baseline;margin:0;font-size:1em;line-height:var(--l1)}
.t::before{content:counter(step)}
.act{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;min-block-size:var(--e6);padding:calc(var(--e-2) - var(--e-12));border:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);font-weight:700;line-height:var(--l1);text-decoration:none}
.act:not(.o),.act.o:is(:hover,:focus-visible){background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.act:not(.o):is(:hover,:focus-visible){background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg)}
.more{margin-inline-start:calc(2*var(--e-2))}
.more>*{margin-block:var(--e-4) 0}
.q{font-weight:700;line-height:var(--l1)}
/* E: the empty place: the next entry of the discussion, drawn as the room draws one (the name as given, the kind as declared) with
   nothing in it yet, and the control that opens the form: a plain link to its page, or, with the popover API, the form where it stands */
.place{position:relative;anchor-name:--place;display:grid;justify-items:start;row-gap:var(--e2);padding:var(--e-2);border:var(--e-16) solid var(--mute)}
.place p{margin:0}
.kind{display:inline-block;padding-inline:var(--e-8);border:var(--e-16) solid var(--mute);border-radius:var(--e-8);font-size:.8409em;white-space:nowrap}
.open{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;box-sizing:border-box;min-block-size:var(--e6);padding:0 var(--e-2);border:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);background:none;color:var(--fg);font:inherit;font-weight:700;line-height:var(--l1);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.open::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0}
.place:hover .open,.open:focus-visible{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
button.open{display:none}
.themes{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.themes a{display:block;padding-block:var(--e-8)}
/* R §9: one answer a machine gave, as its author declared it: user content, marked as every AI entry is */
.ex{padding-inline-start:var(--e-2);border-inline-start:var(--e-8) solid var(--machine)}
.ex p{margin:0}
.ex .content{white-space:pre-wrap}
.kind.ai{border-color:var(--machine);color:var(--machine);font-weight:700}
/* Blueprint §7: the room's own form in the browser's own popover, never taller than the window; from e21, in the place's column where the browser can anchor it */
#reply{display:none;box-sizing:border-box;padding:var(--e0);border:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg)}
#reply h2{margin:0;outline:0;font-size:var(--e1);line-height:var(--l1)}
#reply p{margin:var(--e-2) 0 0}
#reply :is(label,details){display:block;margin-block-start:var(--e-2)}
#reply :is(input,select,textarea){display:block;box-sizing:border-box;inline-size:100%;margin-block-start:var(--e-8);padding:var(--e-4);border:var(--e-16) solid var(--mute);color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg);font:inherit}
#reply textarea{min-block-size:var(--e12);field-sizing:content}
#reply :is(button,input,select){min-block-size:var(--e6)}
#reply summary{padding-block:var(--e-4);cursor:pointer}
#reply>p:last-child{position:sticky;inset-block-end:calc(-1*var(--e0));margin:var(--e-2) calc(-1*var(--e0)) calc(-1*var(--e0));padding:var(--e-2) var(--e0);border-block-start:var(--e-16) solid var(--mute);background:var(--bg)}   /* Close stays in view at the sheet's lower edge */
#reply button{padding:var(--e-4) var(--e0);border:var(--e-16) solid var(--fg);color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg);font:inherit}
@supports selector(:popover-open){
a.open{display:none}
button.open{display:inline-grid}
#reply{inline-size:min(var(--e21),100vw - 2*var(--e-1));max-block-size:calc(100vh - 2*var(--e-1));overflow:auto}
#reply:popover-open{display:block}
#reply::backdrop{background:rgb(0 0 0/.5)}
@supports (anchor-name:--a){@media(min-width:38.0546rem){
#reply{position-anchor:--place;inset:var(--e-1) auto auto anchor(left);margin:0;inline-size:anchor-size(width);min-inline-size:var(--e18);position-try-fallbacks:flip-inline}
}}
}
/* M: the machine's reading is the machine forms themselves: under a label, a command to check it and what this address answers a
   client that asks for application/json, no line broken inside a token (the head folds between words, the body scrolls sideways);
   the Core's SHA-256 as sha256sum prints it; the raw forms; one plain way back */
.col.n{font-family:var(--exact);font-size:var(--e-1)}
.x{margin:0 0 var(--e0);font-size:1em;overflow-x:auto}
:is(.req,.hd)>span{display:inline-block;box-sizing:border-box;max-inline-size:100%;padding-inline-start:var(--e0);text-indent:calc(-1*var(--e0));vertical-align:bottom;white-space:pre-wrap}
:is(.req,.hd)>span>span{white-space:nowrap}
.x .d{color:var(--machine)}
.lbl{margin:0 0 var(--e-8);font:400 1em/var(--l2) var(--human);color:var(--mute)}
.raw{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.raw a{display:block;padding-block:var(--e-8);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.back{margin:var(--e2) 0 0;font:700 var(--e1)/var(--l1) var(--human)}
.back a{display:inline-block;padding-block:var(--e-2)}

/* 8 REASONS. Blueprint 9a: every part has a recorded reason, kept in its data-src; one switch under the line on who reads shows them
   where they apply. M + C: a checkbox and the attributes themselves, set by CSS; without :has() no switch, and the key and the link
   to the table stand open. */
.why{padding-block-end:var(--e-2);text-align:center}
.why p,.key dl,.key dd{margin:0}
.key{margin-block-start:var(--e-4);padding-block:var(--e-2);border-block:var(--e-16) solid var(--why)}
.key dl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;column-gap:var(--e0)}
.key div{display:flex;column-gap:var(--e-4)}
.key dt{font-family:var(--exact);font-weight:700;color:var(--why)}
/* a reason: small, blue, under its part, held to it by a rule */
[data-src]::after{content:attr(data-src);display:none;color:var(--why);font:400 var(--e-1)/var(--l2) var(--human);text-align:start;text-indent:0;text-wrap:pretty;white-space:normal;margin:var(--e-4) 0;padding-inline-start:var(--e-2);border-inline-start:var(--e-16) solid var(--why)}
@supports selector(:has(a)){
.sw{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--e-4);min-block-size:var(--e6);margin-inline-start:var(--e-4);color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer}
.sw input{appearance:none;flex:none;box-sizing:border-box;inline-size:var(--e5);block-size:var(--e1);margin:0;border:var(--e-16) solid;border-radius:var(--e1);
 background:radial-gradient(circle closest-side,currentColor calc(100% - var(--e-8)),transparent calc(100% - var(--e-8) + var(--e-16))) 0 0/var(--e1) 100% no-repeat;cursor:pointer}
.sw input:checked{border-color:var(--why);background-color:var(--why);background-position:100% 0;color:var(--bg)}
@media(forced-colors:active){.sw input{appearance:auto;inline-size:var(--e1);border:0;background:none}}   /* the browser's own box shows the state */
.key{display:none}
.why:has(:checked) .key,:root:has(#why:checked) [data-src]::after{display:block}
/* while the reasons show, the switch stays at the window's lower edge wherever its own place has moved to */
.why:has(:checked){display:contents}
.why:has(:checked)>p{position:sticky;inset-block-end:0;z-index:1;border-block-start:var(--e-16) solid var(--why);background:var(--bg)}
}

/* 9 FOOT. E: who reads; R: eight lines of the Declaration; E: four links named for what they answer; C: where everything is, the
   licence, what the site does not do, what the page weighs. */
.both{margin:0;padding-block:var(--e-2) 0;border-block-start:var(--e-12) solid var(--fg);text-align:center}
.decl,.next,footer{max-inline-size:var(--e21);margin-inline:auto}
.decl{margin-block:var(--e5) var(--e2);text-align:center}
.decl h2{margin:0 0 var(--e-2);font-size:var(--e1);line-height:var(--l1)}
blockquote{margin:0 0 var(--e-2);font-size:var(--e1)}
blockquote p,.decl .src{margin:0}
.next{margin-block:0 var(--e5);text-align:center}
footer{padding-block:var(--e0) var(--e4);border-block-start:var(--e-16) solid var(--fg)}
footer p{margin:0 0 var(--e-2)}
footer .src{font-size:1em}
.foot{columns:2 var(--e14);column-gap:var(--e3);margin:var(--e0) 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.foot li{break-inside:avoid}
.foot a{display:inline-block;padding-block:var(--e-8)}

/* 10 MOTION. E: one movement as the page opens (the figure turns from the day before to today); after that nothing moves unless the
   reader moves it: the figure by a day at a press, the line between the readings at a door; between pages the site's own fade, and the mark travels to its place on the next page. H: none of it for a reader who asks for less motion (2.3.3). */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
@view-transition{navigation:auto}
.name svg{view-transition-name:cz-mark}
.page{transition:--open .8409s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1)}
